warnings: VLM notes: 1. The diagram shows a heat exchanger E-234-009 (vendor package, NOTE 7) served by two parallel pump/fan trains (A and B) each with vibration monitoring, MCC motor control, hand switches, sequencing logic, and ESD-3200 emergency shutdown. 2. Two RS (ring-seal or rated spectacle) isolation valve pairs are shown on each side of the exchanger with 8-inch spectacle blinds at 0 (open) position. 3. TY-2911 is a computing relay that aggregates temperature signals; H-234-001 TRIP is referenced as a heater or fired equipment trip system on the right side. 4. PSD-2917 appears to be a pressure/temperature shutdown device associated with H-234-001 trip (possibly a heater burner management system reference off this sheet). 5. F3D and CD3D labels on right bottom outlet are off-page connector references. 6. NOTE 2: CSO (car-sealed open) valves on left inlet. NOTE 8: KV-2904 valve details. NOTE 9: HS-2901A/B local hand switches. NOTE 4,10: local START/STOP and EMERGENCY STOP pushbuttons. NOTE 12: off-page connector at bottom right. 7. MCC symbols (crossed-line circle) represent motor control centres rather than traditional P&ID valve symbols — interpreted as motor starters/contactors. 8. FL inline symbol on KV-2904 utility line indicates flow limiting orifice. 9. Circular tank/accumulator symbols visible between pump trains likely represent pulsation dampeners or suction/discharge pots for the pump sets. 10. Image resolution limits certainty on some tag suffixes and minor symbols.
Extraction confidence (0.78) below threshold (0.85). Consider DEXPI input for validation.

fault_diagnosis.repair_procedure:
PRIORITY REPAIR ACTIONS (Critical fault modes):
Reference: IEC 61511:2016+AMD1 Clause 5.2 — Functional Safety Management

  [TI-2909] LOW
    Effect  : Heating ramp-up — risk of overtemperature
    Detect  : NAMUR NE 107 Failure alarm
    Action  : Check wire continuity; replace sensor element

  [VSHH-2901A] FAIL_TO_OPERATE
    Effect  : Safety function fails dangerously — hazard not detected
    Detect  : SIL proof-test; PFDavg calculation
    Action  : Immediate proof-test; replace if failed; review SIL maintenance schedule

SAFETY INSTRUMENTED FUNCTION MAINTENANCE:
  Per IEC 61511-1:2016 Clause 16 (Proof testing):
  — Loop 2917: Verify sensor TT-2917, logic, and actuator PSD-2917 per SIL proof-test schedule.
  — Loop 2901A: Verify sensor VSHH-2901A, logic, and actuator MCC-2901A per SIL proof-test schedule.
  — Loop 2901B: Verify sensor VSHH-2901B, logic, and actuator MCC-2901B per SIL proof-test schedule.
